Name: Visual Pregnancy
Author: DomesticKitsune
Description:
Alters shirts and the female Farmer sprites when the player is pregnant. Works in bath house. Tested with 1.6. Most shirts are altered!

Compatible with:
-MOST MODS! Anything that doesn't alter shirts or the farmer body (i.e., Stardew Valley Expanded, expansion mods, graphical mods other than ones altering the Farmer sprite)
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] (except shirts)
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7618]Furry Farmer[/url] (currently only canine, with Furry Farmer Edition)

Partially compatible with:
-[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]More Elegant Farmer Body[/url] (bathhouse sprites are incompatible and look strange)

Incompatible with:﻿
-Anything that does alter shirts or the farmer's body

=IMPORTANT NOTE=
Most shirts have been altered to reflect pregnancy, but there are some in which it just doesn't show well or wouldn't logically show much (such as the armor sets). If the mod doesn't seem to work, try swapping shirts (jackets have the most visible change!)

Incompatibility may just include not showing up, not affecting modded shirts or strange visuals on conflicting Farmer/Shirts overwrite mods. It shouldn't cause any sort of crash or loading issues.

Recommended mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6578]Pregnancy and Birth Events[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12869]Planned Parenthood[/url]
